what: The remakes corpus with no model (PLAN.md Sections 9 and 15): counts, the word columns extended by rule, what the word model settles, and the calibration of the decision test on the final list. Made by `remakes.py words`. 'run' reads the word columns, the panel and the stand-ins' results from this file and refuses if the inputs below have changed.

extension_of_the_word_columns.goes_on_while: more than 10% of the stand-ins that are not yet columns have p below 0.05, or any of them has p below 0.01

cells.every other set and frame, and every sim: cells the word model gives a probability under 1e-08 are left out of the slope (remake_test's cache_prune)

frame_set.primary: indian industries other than the remake's own
frame_set.firm_other_cross_industry: any industry other than the remake's own

set.films: indian industries other than the remake's own

word_columns.rule: On the primary set under frame set (all entries, hub-corrected form, every cell): while more than 10% of the stand-ins that are not yet word columns have p below 0.05, or any of them has p below 0.01, the one with the lowest p joins the word columns in both forms and the word model is refitted. At most 20 additions. Decided with words alone, before any unit exists.
